commentary_segments.text: The main advantage of this first principle of CMFB is that no additional power is required. The main disadvantage is that this CMFB amplifier may not be sufficiently fast, depending on the application. This second principle has exactly the opposite characteristics. It takes two more stages, resulting in much more power consumption. The speed however, can be set independently of the differential amplifier, and can be made as large as the designer likes.
